name: Saarlouis (Germany)
description: White field charged at the centre with the city arms of Saarlouis (fleurs-de-lis and a sun on white within a wreath, with a crown and the motto DISSIPAT ATQUE FOVET).
history: Municipal flag of Saarlouis; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Saarlouis arms — fleurs-de-lis and sun with crown, wreath and motto
